promise: Constitutional ban on re-election of any popularly elected office, promised to take effect in 2027
description: The anti-re-election rule was published 1 Apr 2025, but its implementation was postponed from 2027 to 2030.

promise: Defeat inflation ('kill inflation', the overriding goal of his first year)
description: Annual inflation fell from 211.4% (2023) and 254.2% (first month) to 117.8% (2024) and ~31.8% by Sept 2025, with monthly inflation at a five-year low of 1.5% (June 2025) — a huge reduction, though inflation was not eliminated.

promise: Increase defence spending to 2.5% of GDP
description: The 2.5%-by-2027 pledge was confirmed, funded by cutting international aid from 0.5% to 0.3% of GNI.

promise: Restore sound public finances / keep the deficit on a path toward the EU's 3% of GDP ceiling
description: The deficit was 5.8% of GDP in 2024 (up from 5.4% in 2023 and at risk of exceeding 6%), public debt reached 116.5% of GDP in 2025, and the 3% target is far out of reach.

promise: xAI would expand the Colossus supercomputer to 1 million GPUs (a tenfold increase)
description: Three months after the first 100,000 H100s came online at Colossus (built in 122 days, Sept 2024), xAI announced the 30-acre Memphis expansion toward 1 million GPUs, reported by the FT as 'Musk plans to expand Colossus tenfold'. Growth is ongoing (200k GPUs by late 2024; ~230k by June 2025) but the 1M milestone had not been publicly confirmed as of mid-2026.
evidence: Colossus built in 122 days with 100k H100s (Wikipedia: Colossus)
FT (Dec 4, 2024): plans to expand Colossus tenfold to ~1M GPUs
By June 2025: 150k H100s + 50k H200s + 30k GB200s, more planned

promise: Nvidia expects to sell $1 trillion of AI hardware through 2027
description: At GTC 2026 Huang forecast NVIDIA would sell ~$1 trillion in AI hardware by the end of 2027 (per Tom's Hardware, Mar 16, 2026), building on a $500B order book (Nov 2025) and 'trillions more' infrastructure claims. Hard revenue promise with a 2027 deadline, still pending as of mid-2026.
evidence: Tom's Hardware (Mar 16, 2026): 'Jensen Huang expects Nvidia to sell $1 trillion of AI hardware through 2027'
Nvidia's $500B order book reported Nov 17, 2025
GTC 2026 keynote: 'By 2027, market demand will exceed $1 trillion' (WEEX transcript)

promise: Make Europe independent from Russian fossil fuels, ending reliance on Russian gas by 2027
description: The European Commission's REPowerEU plan, presented in May 2022 after Russia's invasion of Ukraine, set the goal of ending the EU's dependence on Russian fossil fuels, including a full phase-out of Russian gas, well before 2030 and by 2027 at the latest. The EU cut Russian gas imports by roughly 75% between 2021 and 2025, and in January 2026 adopted legislation banning Russian LNG imports from the start of 2027 and pipeline gas from autumn 2027.
evidence: Russian gas imports cut by about 75% between 2021 and 2025
EU regulation banning Russian LNG from January 2027 and pipeline gas from autumn 2027 approved in January 2026
National phase-out plans were due to the Commission by 1 March 2026
sources: PubAffairs Bruxelles / Council of the EU

promise: Deliver equal prize money for the men's and women's World Cups by 2027
description: FIFA president Gianni Infantino said in 2023 that FIFA's goal was equal prize money for the men's and women's World Cups by 2027, a pledge widely reported at the 2023 Women's World Cup. FIFA announced a record $655 million prize pool for the 2026 men's World Cup (up from $440 million in 2022) and has stated its intent to reach parity for the 2027 Women's World Cup, which remains forthcoming.
evidence: Infantino pledged parity 'by 2027' in 2023
2026 men's prize pool is a record $655m, nearly six times the 2023 women's $110m pool
US men's and women's teams agreed to share 80% of 2026/2027 prize earnings equally

promise: Optimus robots will be produced en masse at a cost below $20,000, available in three to five years
description: At AI Day (September 30, 2022) Musk said Tesla would produce the Optimus humanoid robot en masse at a cost lower than $20,000 and that it would be available in three to five years. As of August 2026 Optimus remained in factory-trial and prototype stages with no consumer availability or announced price — the sub-$20,000 mass-produced robot had not materialized.
evidence: No Optimus consumer sales or price announced as of mid-2026
Optimus still demonstrated only in factory-trial footage

promise: Open selected sectors and occupations to workers from Timor-Leste from 2027
description: During his visit to Dili, PM Wong announced that Singapore would open selected sectors and occupations to workers from Timor-Leste from 2027. From the second half of 2027, Timor-Leste will be an approved non-traditional source country for Work Permit holders, with construction and marine shipyard among the sectors opened.
evidence: Announced July 2-3, 2026 in Dili alongside PM Xanana Gusmão
Timor-Leste to become approved non-traditional source country from H2 2027

promise: Provide at least €70 billion in military support for Ukraine in 2026, with an equivalent level planned for 2027
description: At the Ankara Summit in July 2026, NATO allies agreed on major new defence investments including at least €70 billion in military support for Ukraine in 2026, with an equivalent level planned for 2027. The summit also demanded allies present credible plans toward the 5%-of-GDP spending target.
evidence: Ankara Summit (July 8, 2026) committed at least €70bn for Ukraine in 2026
Equivalent level planned for 2027; delivery still in progress

promise: NVIDIA's combined Blackwell and Vera Rubin order pipeline will reach $1 trillion through 2027
description: At GTC 2026, Huang said NVIDIA's combined Blackwell and Vera Rubin purchase-order pipeline now targets $1 trillion through 2027 - double the $500 billion opportunity projected a year earlier - as Rubin began shipping in 2026 and Feynman was scheduled for 2028.
evidence: $1 trillion pipeline target stated at GTC 2026 (March 2026)
Pipeline doubles the $500bn projected at GTC 2025

promise: "We're planning to make Optimus robots available for sale to the public by the end of 2027"
description: Speaking at the World Economic Forum in Davos, Musk said Tesla plans to begin selling Optimus humanoid robots to the public by the end of 2027, at a price of $20,000-$30,000, once reliability and safety are high enough. He predicted there will eventually be more robots than people.
evidence: WEF Davos panel, January 22, 2026
Axios and Entrepreneur reported the end-2027 public sales timeline

promise: "The Terafab is bringing cutting-edge manufacturing to America, creating thousands of high-paying jobs in the Lone Star State, and enabling us to produce AI chips at scale for use on Earth and in space."
description: SpaceX and Tesla committed an initial $16.8 billion to build Terafab, a vertically integrated semiconductor plant in Grimes County, Texas, with over 100 million square feet of manufacturing space and at least 3,000 jobs. The facility is expected to produce chips for Tesla's Optimus robots and Cybercabs and for SpaceX's space-based data centers, with production expected to begin in 2027.
evidence: SpaceX and Tesla confirmed the $16.8 billion phase-1 commitment on August 6, 2026
Local reporting says production at the Grimes County plant is expected to begin in 2027

promise: Provide Ukraine a 90-billion-euro loan to support its government and military over the next two years
description: European Union leaders reached a hard-fought agreement on December 19, 2025 to provide Ukraine a 90-billion-euro loan designed to keep the country's government and military operational over the next two years. The financing, backed by the EU's common budget, came after more than 24 hours of negotiations in Brussels, where talks were initially stalled over whether to use frozen Russian assets to fund the plan. European Parliament later approved enhanced cooperation for the loan.
evidence: Agreement announced by European Council President Antonio Costa, December 19-20, 2025
European Parliament approved enhanced cooperation mechanism for the 90-billion-euro loan

promise: Commit close to 74 million euros to the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) under the Global Health Resilience Initiative
description: The European Commission committed close to 74 million euros to CEPI as part of the Global Health Resilience Initiative, reinforcing joint efforts to accelerate vaccine research and development and improve the world's ability to respond rapidly to health emergencies. The announcement came amid a fresh Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. No disbursement deadline was disclosed; end of 2027 is used as a review horizon.
evidence: Commitment announced May 20, 2026 under the Global Health Resilience Initiative
No disbursement timeline disclosed; review horizon end of 2027

role: Nvidia / OpenAI Ohio data center financing
promise: Provide a financial guarantee for OpenAI's Ohio data center project, planned at up to $250 billion and scaled back to under $120 billion covering only the first phase
description: Nvidia and OpenAI were nearing an agreement in mid-August 2026 under which the chipmaker would provide a financial backstop for OpenAI's 10-gigawatt Ohio data center campus developed with SoftBank's SB Energy. The Wall Street Journal reported that the planned guarantee was cut from about $250 billion to below $120 billion, covering only the first phase of the project, as Nvidia shifted AI financing risk toward a broader $500 billion compute-financing platform. No completion deadline was disclosed; end of 2027 is used as a review horizon.
evidence: WSJ report (August 13-14, 2026): guarantee scaled back from ~$250 billion to under $120 billion
Reuters/ET and edgen.tech: backstop now covers only phase 1 of the 10-GW Ohio campus
